name: FRONTKN
recent: Frontken 在 2026 年 11 月 6 日公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日的季度业绩，净利按年增长 71% 至 RM57.25m，营收按年增长 15.7% 至 RM181.04m。同期，公司宣布董事会及提名委员会人事变动，包括 Ng Wai Pin 的董事变动以及 Chiu Yoong Chian Gerald 自 2027 年 1 月 1 日起卸任提名委员会成员。此外，雇员公积金局 (EPF) 与 Prudential PLC 在 10 月至 11 月期间有多项股权变动申报。
notable: 公司公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度业绩，净利按年增长 71% 至 RM57.25m。
公司宣布董事会变动，Ng Wai Pin 出现董事职位变动。
公司宣布提名委员会变动，Chiu Yoong Chian Gerald 自 2027 年 1 月 1 日起卸任提名委员会成员。
risks: 雇员公积金局 (EPF) 在 2026 年 10 月至 11 月期间有多项股权变动申报。
Prudential PLC 在 2026 年 10 月至 11 月期间有多项股权变动申报。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日季度，营收为 RM181.04m，按年增长 15.7%，按季下降 3.1%；净利为 RM57.25m，按年增长 71.0%，按季增长 20.0%；净利率为 31.6%，高于上一季度的 25.5%。

recent_en: Frontken announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 6 November 2026, with net profit up 71% year-on-year to RM57.25m and revenue up 15.7% year-on-year to RM181.04m. In the same period, the company announced board and nomination committee changes, including a boardroom change for Ng Wai Pin and the cessation of Chiu Yoong Chian Gerald as a nomination committee member effective 1 January 2027. In addition, the Employees Provident Fund Board and Prudential PLC filed multiple changes in substantial shareholder interests between October and November.
notable_en: The company announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026, with net profit up 71% year-on-year to RM57.25m.
The company announced a boardroom change involving Ng Wai Pin.
The company announced a nomination committee change, with Chiu Yoong Chian Gerald ceasing to be a member effective 1 January 2027.
risks_en: The Employees Provident Fund Board filed multiple changes in substantial shareholder interests between October and November 2026.
Prudential PLC filed multiple changes in substantial shareholder interests between October and November 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 September 2026, revenue was RM181.04m, up 15.7% year-on-year and down 3.1% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was RM57.25m, up 71.0% year-on-year and up 20.0% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 31.6%, higher than 25.5% in the previous quarter.
